action_inputs.description: CloudBolt Environment to deploy into. Lists the Azure-backed environments the ordering group may use (group.get_available_environments()). Its resource handler supplies the subscription and tenant written to the workspace as ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID / ARM_TENANT_ID environment variables. The handler is never exposed.
action_inputs.label: Environment
action_inputs.name: env_id

action_inputs.description: JSON object of the no-code module's variable name/value pairs, funneled from the order form's Dynamic Panel (field names match the module's variables). Supplied by the custom form; leave a field blank to fall back to the module's default (an empty payload parses to {}). The reserved '_sensitive' key marks variables written to TFC as sensitive; the reserved 'deployment_name' key names the CloudBolt resource and is not sent to terraform.
action_inputs.label: Module Variables (JSON)
action_inputs.name: parameters

action_inputs.description: Terraform Cloud/Enterprise connection to provision through (a 'tf-cloud'-labeled ConnectionInfo global_id). Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults on the build item -- not selected on the order form.
action_inputs.label: TF Cloud Connection
action_inputs.name: tfc_connection_info

action_inputs.description: The no-code module this blueprint deploys (a nocode-* module ID from the org's private registry). Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults -- one blueprint targets one module. Find the ID via the HCP UI or by following a registry module's relationships (see docs/hcp-no-code-setup.md).
action_inputs.label: TFC No-Code Module ID
action_inputs.name: tfc_nocode_module_id

action_inputs.description: HCP Terraform organization the deployment's workspace is created in. Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults.
action_inputs.label: TFC Organization
action_inputs.name: tfc_organization

action_inputs.description: HCP Terraform project that holds the deployment's workspace (a project-scoped variable set supplies the cloud credentials). Pinned per blueprint via parameter_defaults.
action_inputs.label: TFC Project
action_inputs.name: tfc_project

description: Provisions infrastructure from a pinned HCP Terraform no-code module into a chosen CloudBolt environment's Azure subscription, with a plan-approval pause before apply.
name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module
